topic.en: Self-evolving agents as a general machine-learning problem: constrained continual improvement, causal credit assignment, memory and skill consolidation, self-correction, curriculum evolution, workflow search, evaluator evolution, and world-model adaptation
topic.zh: 把 Agent 自进化视为一般机器学习问题：受约束持续改进、因果归因、记忆与技能巩固、自纠正、课程进化、工作流搜索、评价器进化与世界模型适应

hard_constraints: The main contribution must define a general learning problem or mechanism rather than a visual-only application trick
The evolving object and update operator must be explicit and identifiable against strong simple baselines
Persistent improvement must be separated from extra inference compute, retrieval, reranking, or test-set adaptation
Every update must be evaluated for regression, feedback integrity, out-of-loop generalization, and matched cost
A bounded pilot using no more than two GPUs and 48 GPU-hours must be able to falsify the key intuition
The main result must use open weights; commercial APIs may appear only as optional ceilings or audited judges
